_camera.why: Content is the WEST wall (metal sculpture, return-air grille, two doorways) and the NORTH wall (the master-bedroom cased opening the primary photo looks straight at). doll_se culls south + east and leaves exactly that pair standing -- and the east wall it culls is the only blank one in the room. The shell pass chose doll_nw, which culls the west wall and would leave the sculpture hanging in mid-air.
